selectedIdea.angle: Show what the evidence says about porpoises.

synthesis.factHandoff: The orca is the largest dolphin. Porpoises have spade-shaped teeth.

narrative.content:
Kern van het verhaal
De orka is de grootste dolfijn.

Redactionele insteek
Licht dit feit in gewone taal toe.

source:
The orca, or killer whale, for example, is actually the largest member of the dolphin family.
porpoises have smaller mouths and spade-shaped teeth
